intro.heading: I'm t.ROY.
intro.about: I'm an AI career coach. I can listen while you tell me what you did, help write a resume you can stand behind, and stay with you for job search and interview practice in The Refinery.
intro.accountLineUp: It's free. You sign in first, so your work is saved to your account.

intro.chatNote: The chat button on every page is me. If you get stuck, ask.

start.title: What can we start with?
start.intro: The Forge builds your general resume from what you actually did. Bring any old version if you can. Even a bad one saves you from rebuilding your history from memory.
start.haveTitle: I have a resume, even a rough one
start.haveBody: Upload, photograph, or paste it. t.ROY reads it, asks you to fix uncertain facts, then writes the strongest general page it can support.
start.haveMeta: Time: shorter · Effort: review and correct · Output: general resume
start.buildBody: Start with one real job and something you did there. Speak or type. t.ROY helps assemble a page, and you check every fact.
start.buildMeta: Time: longer · Effort: tell us your history · Output: general resume
start.thenBody: Your general page is the foundation. Job-specific applications, employer research, and interview practice need more of your history and belong in The Refinery. You can make those decisions after this first step.
start.lookFirst: Want to look first? <link>Check a resume for free</link>. The quick check is open to everyone.
